currentWork.title: Operational field use — FINAL.21 simplified workflow verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.21 is merged and production verified. The user-facing report-photo/OCR entry point and Analysis tab/page were removed because field operation does not have time for photo capture. Historical Analytics data and code were preserved; no destructive data deletion or DB/schema migration occurred. Saved manual next-workday plans now carry into the actual workday by materializing planned additions/exclusions through the existing per-day force/skip mechanism. Urgent orders remain visible as the existing safety override. PR #136 merged to main at 344e97b0ae14c7487b8119c53892a95a3a7cd9c8. PR browser run 37290348056 and main run 37290505765 passed; GitHub Pages run 37290504048 and Vercel production status passed.
scope: Use VENDRIVE as a schedule/task/order/visit tool without the report-photo/OCR entry point.
Do not expose the Analysis tab/page in the field UI.
Preserve historical Analytics storage/code for compatibility and non-destructive rollback; do not collect new OCR data through the removed UI.
When a manual next-workday plan is saved, carry its additions/exclusions into that date using the existing force/skip semantics.
Do not allow a saved manual plan to suppress an urgent order; orders remain visible in Today.
Apply a matching saved plan once even if the old app already set the current-day marker before FINAL.21 first loads.
Keep task/order/visit completion semantics, Analytics engine AN14B3B5, DB 4 and schema 4 otherwise unchanged.
Use GitHub Actions + Playwright/Chromium as the deterministic browser regression path.
nextActions: Use the simplified app normally and confirm the five-tab navigation has no Analysis tab and Today has no report-photo button.
At the next saved next-workday plan, confirm added/excluded machines appear correctly when that date becomes Today.
Reopen engineering only for new field friction or explicit product changes.

unresolved: Numeric learning promotion remains disabled; historical analysis evidence is preserved but the user-facing analysis workflow is withdrawn.
